findings.message: A successful invocation now closes the channel supplied by its caller. The captured client expects to send more data through that same channel after transmit returns. For callers using a valid argument form, this cleanup breaks subsequent channel reuse. Leave borrowed channels open unless ownership transfer is an explicit API contract.
